description: This file defines the Flask application class, including methods for request handling, response processing, error handling, URL generation, and server running. It implements core WSGI application logic for Flask.

classes.name: Flask
classes.description: A subclass of the Flask application implementing WSGI interface, request/response handling, error management, URL building, server execution, and context management.

methods.name: app_context
methods.description: Creates an application context, pushing current app and g.

methods.name: request_context
methods.description: Creates a request context from a WSGI environment.

methods.name: test_request_context
methods.description: Creates a test request context with specified parameters.

methods.name: wsgi_app
methods.description: Main WSGI application callable, dispatches requests.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: WSGI interface, calls wsgi_app.

methods.name: handle_http_exception
methods.description: Handles HTTP exceptions, invoking error handlers.

methods.name: handle_user_exception
methods.description: Handles general exceptions, forwarding HTTPExceptions.

methods.name: handle_exception
methods.description: Handles unhandled exceptions, returning 500 responses.

methods.name: log_exception
methods.description: Logs exceptions to the app logger.

methods.name: dispatch_request
methods.description: Dispatches request to view function based on URL rule.

methods.name: full_dispatch_request
methods.description: Performs full request dispatch including pre/post processing and error handling.

methods.name: finalize_request
methods.description: Converts view return value into Response, applies response processing.

methods.name: make_default_options_response
methods.description: Creates default OPTIONS response.

methods.name: ensure_sync
methods.description: Wraps async functions to run synchronously.

methods.name: async_to_sync
methods.description: Converts async coroutine to sync function.

methods.name: url_for
methods.description: Generates URLs for endpoints.

methods.name: make_response
methods.description: Converts view return value into a Response object.

methods.name: preprocess_request
methods.description: Runs before request handlers, including before_request functions.

methods.name: process_response
methods.description: Modifies response before sending, including after_request functions.

methods.name: do_teardown_request
methods.description: Runs after request, before context is popped, for cleanup.

methods.name: do_teardown_appcontext
methods.description: Runs before app context is popped, for cleanup.

methods.name: create_jinja_environment
methods.description: Creates Jinja environment with Flask globals and filters.

methods.name: create_url_adapter
methods.description: Creates URL adapter for URL building and matching.

methods.name: raise_routing_exception
methods.description: Handles routing exceptions, possibly raising errors.

methods.name: update_template_context
methods.description: Injects request, session, config, g into template context.

methods.name: make_shell_context
methods.description: Creates context for interactive shell.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs development server with options for host, port, debug, etc.

methods.name: test_client
methods.description: Creates a test client for unit testing.

methods.name: test_cli_runner
methods.description: Creates a CLI runner for testing CLI commands.
